title: PoliTok-DE: A Multimodal Dataset of Political TikToks and Deletions From Germany
benchmark_measurement: Measurement of 'eudaimonic entertainment', which is defined in the codebook as content conveying inspiring, touching, thought-provoking, and meaningful elements. This category includes the conveyance of 'religiousness/spirituality' and the use of 'religious and spiritual symbols'.
findings: The paper does not report specific findings on religion. It finds that 37.3% of the annotated subset of deleted posts conveyed 'eudaimonic entertainment', a category which is defined to include 'religiousness/spirituality' and 'religious and spiritual symbols' as possible manifestations.
